verifiedSurfaceSummary: Verified on Sunday, July 26, 2026 that https://parkplus.io/careers is Park+'s official first-party careers page. It displays generic Sales Manager location labels but exposes no job detail pages, application links, or official ATS feed that can be reliably enumerated. This literal CSV-name provider therefore fails closed and returns no jobs until Park+ publishes a verifiable public application surface.
